records.name: SQL COALESCE Function (Short-circuit evaluation)
silent_gotchas: In Python, `val1 or val2` is NOT identical to COALESCE because `0 or 5` evaluates to 5 in Python, whereas `COALESCE(0, 5)` evaluates to 0!
migration_preservation_rules: In Python, implement COALESCE as: `val1 if val1 is not None else val2` (never use `val1 or val2` when 0 or '' is valid)

records.name: Oracle SQL Empty String Treatment as NULL
records.equality_behavior: In Oracle: '' IS NULL is TRUE; '' = '' is UNKNOWN (treated as NULL)
records.aggregation_behavior: Excluded from aggregate functions in Oracle
silent_gotchas: Queries expecting Oracle empty string semantics will break when ported to PostgreSQL or Python where '' is a distinct valid non-null string
migration_preservation_rules: When migrating Oracle SQL to Python, explicitly test: `val is None or val == ''`
